h1.en: How Integrated Mixer Pump Separates Pressure from Output
h1.zh: 搅拌泵一体机怎样把压力和输送量分成两格

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints the Integrated Mixer Pump in Xingtai with Theoretical Output 21 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa. Output is a volume rate. Pressure is a separate cell on the same sheet. The frame titled “Pump” shows Close up of a Regenerative Turbine Pump Impeller inside of a T51 Series pump from MTH Pumps. That frame does not print these two cells, and another maker's plate is not copied onto this model.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把搅拌泵一体机的理论输送量印成21 m³/h，把最大出口压力印成23 MPa。输送量是体积流量。压力是同一页上的另一格。标题为「Pump」的画面主体是Close up of a Regenerative Turbine 泵 叶轮 inside of a T51 Series 泵 from MTH 泵s。这一帧没有印出这两格，也不会把别的厂家铭牌抄到这个型号上。

body.en: On the Integrated Mixer Pump sheet, Theoretical Output is 21 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 23 MPa. A piston pump pushes concrete into the line; a squeeze pump flattens a hose from outside. Either way, m³/h is not MPa. Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³. Max. Aggregate Size 4 cm and below. Delivery Pipe Diameter 100 / 125 mm.
body.zh: 在搅拌泵一体机这一页，理论输送量是21 m³/h，最大出口压力是23 MPa。活塞泵把混凝土推进管路，挤压泵从外面压扁软管。无论哪一种，立方米每小时都不是兆帕。料斗容积 0.4 m³。最大骨料粒径 4 cm and below。输送管内径 100 / 125 mm。

heading.en: What the frame is allowed to show

body.en: The frame comes from en.wikipedia.org, page “Pump”. Its subject is Close up of a Regenerative Turbine Pump Impeller inside of a T51 Series pump from MTH Pumps. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not treat that caption as a nameplate for the Integrated Mixer Pump. Stroke length, cycle rate and price are absent from both the caption and this catalogue row.
body.zh: 这一帧来自 en.wikipedia.org 的页面「Pump」。画面主体是Close up of a Regenerative Turbine 泵 叶轮 inside of a T51 Series 泵 from MTH 泵s。河北品锦机械不把这句说明当成搅拌泵一体机的铭牌。行程、冲次和价格在说明文字和这一行目录里都没有。

body.en: The Xingtai row does not print a service interval, a seal torque, an export destination or a job case. Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³. Max. Aggregate Size 4 cm and below. Delivery Pipe Diameter 100 / 125 mm. Those printed extras are still not a stroke length.
body.zh: 邢台这一行没有印保养小时间隔、密封扭矩、出口国家或工程案例。料斗容积 0.4 m³。最大骨料粒径 4 cm and below。输送管内径 100 / 125 mm。这些已印的附加格仍然不是行程。
